From: Claire Morton <security@clearhaven.com>
To: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Tenant key eviction rehearsal — evidence & runbook request

Hi Hannah,

Thanks again for taking this on. As part of our SIG + SOC2 check we need evidence for an upcoming tenant key eviction rehearsal (we're running a cross-tenant failover test on 2027-06-21). Broadly we need:

- The runbook you would execute for an emergency tenant key eviction (steps, operator roles, expected timelines).
- Representative K/V cache traces and prefix cache snapshots from a rehearsal run (redacted tenant IDs okay).
- Operator shift logs for the window that includes any key rotation or eviction operations (sample CSV is fine).
- Hash of the keystore snapshot taken at the start and end of the rehearsal; please include the algorithm used (SHA256 preferred).
- Any fallback policy docs (how you route requests when a tenant key is evicted).

I've attached a short SIG evidence intake form (Clearhaven_SIG_Request_Form.pdf) with a few required fields our auditor wants filled. Ideally we get the materials by EOD 2027-06-15 so our auditor can ingest them before the rehearsal.

Small ask: if you can include a short note on how you validate that evicted keys are not accepted by the runtime (e.g., automated negative test or manual validation steps), that will speed review.

Thanks,
Claire Morton
Senior InfoSec Manager, Clearhaven

Attachment: Clearhaven_SIG_Request_Form.pdf
From: hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
To: jonas_weber@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Tenant key eviction rehearsal — evidence & runbook request

Jonas / Marissa — forwarding Clearhaven's ask (below). Auditor deadline EOD 6/15. Can you please own pulling together a compact evidence bundle and a concise runbook? Priority list: runbook (clear operator steps + play roles), start/end keystore snapshot hashes, kv-cache traces (redact tenant IDs), and operator shiftlog samples.

Jonas — can you produce the kv-cache traces + snapshot hash?
Marissa — can you author a 2-3 page runbook and the negative-test validation steps (how we confirm an evicted key is rejected at runtime)?

Let's keep this minimal — auditors only need representative artifacts and a clear narrative. If you hit any blockers I can escalate to ops.

Thanks,
Hannah
Director, Security & Trust
Redwood Inference

Hannah / Marissa — putting together the artifacts now. Quick notes on contents:

1) eviction_rehearsal-runbook.md (draft) — operator checklist, preconditions, step-by-step eviction procedure, rollback steps, confirmation checks.
2) kvcache-traces-20270614.zip — includes a 10-minute sample of prefix hits/misses and the KV eviction markers (tenant IDs redacted as discussed).
3) operator-shiftlog-samples.csv — sample entries across three shifts showing operator ID, action, timestamp, and ticket reference.
4) keystore-snapshot-hashes.txt — contains SHA256(start_snapshot) and SHA256(end_snapshot) values plus the snapshot generation commands.

I ran the negative test locally: after a simulated key revocation the runtime returns 401 with error code EVICTED_KEY for all token-signing attempts and the call is logged with tracer id; I'll include the exact curl + expected output in the runbook.

Uploading the bundle to the secured intake link now (REQ-4523). ETA for the zipped bundle: 30–45 minutes.

— Jonas
Principal Engineer, Runtime

Attachment: eviction_rehearsal-runbook.md; kvcache-traces-20270614.zip; operator-shiftlog-samples.csv; keystore-snapshot-hashes.txt

Subject: Re: Tenant key eviction rehearsal — evidence & runbook request

Hannah — thanks, received the bundle via REQ-4523. Quick clarification: the auditor wants the timestamped evidence that the start/end snapshot hashes were generated from the same snapshot procedure (we ask for a signed manifest or an automated job id). Could you include the job id from the snapshot job (or a DocuSign-signed manifest) and the cron/log entry that shows the exact generation time?

Also, the auditor requested the hash algorithm in the manifest (please confirm SHA256) and a short note confirming that the keystore snapshot was created from the canonical keystore (path and manifest id OK to redact tenant IDs).

If it's easier we can accept the job id + stdout snippet from the snapshot command — that should satisfy the trace. Can you get that over before EOD today?

Claire
Senior InfoSec Manager, Clearhaven
